description: Source code for 'luac', the Lua compiler that saves bytecodes to files and can list bytecodes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the 'luac' program, processes command-line arguments, loads files, and outputs bytecode or listings.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines multiple Lua prototypes into a single prototype, used for compiling multiple files.

methods.name: pmain
methods.description: Performs the main processing: loads files, combines prototypes, and dumps or lists bytecodes.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the program.

methods.name: cannot
methods.description: Prints an error message related to file operations and exits.
